message.content: (Leans over, pointing ahead)  Look, we're passing Kinderdijk! Imagine, right here in South Holland, there's this charming village that's packed with history. Back around 1740, people built nineteen monumental windmills here, all used to drain the Alblasserwaard polder. It’s quite a sight, and it was recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site back in 1997.
